title: HackOps: The Operator's Manual
author: Field notes for Harsh Kasana
description: How your hackathon system actually works and how to run it so you spend your weeks building instead of tracking — the pipeline in PROJECTS/Me/hack-ops, why selection matters more than speed, the thin-track theory your own record proves, what to build and how to find it, and the downstream layer where the real money has always been.
